subject: Close retained AfterScript Think calls at their recursive engine boundaries
description: `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_SuN1Sh1nE/Profile_004/Savegame_013/replay-002-session-0001.jsonl.zst` diverged in Original frame 1710 because Civilian37's retained `EVENT_AFTER_SCRIPT_GO_ON` queue contained two `EVENT_PANIC` siblings. Original logs and enters the outer AfterScript Think, then recursively calls `Think(stimulus)` for each retained sibling in order; the first Panic synchronously completes its actor-side no-door branch and recursive `Think(EVENT_REACHPOINT)` before the second sibling begins. The Friendly dispatch and retained-queue boundaries are `original-code/RHartificialbonhomie.cpp:110-145` and `original-code/RHartificialbonhomie.cpp:631-660`; the corresponding Enemy boundaries are `original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:320-363` and `original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:6009-6035`; Panic's direction, distance, and direct ReachPoint boundaries are `original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:1996`, `original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:2030`, and `original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:3057-3073`. Rust drained both siblings inside one borrowed AI handler, so their single-slot actor outbox requests coalesced and the second Panic replaced the first before the engine could execute it. Rust consequently omitted Original's reach-point direction and segment draws at compatible offsets 1170172 and 1170217. Commit `233012233` suspends only the admitted outer AfterScript handler while preserving its StartThink/log/priority order, then closes retained siblings one at a time through the engine, checks locks before each pop, skips duplicate AfterScript markers only when reached, and runs the outer tail plus EndThink last against freshly rebuilt live context and typed tick data. The suspension marker is transient and excluded from serde and state hashing. Follow-up `3c48d625b` provisions the newly reached panic-boundary test with its truthful Enemy hand-to-hand weapon id/profile and asserts the route-less recursive completion's source-authored `FleeingHiding`/Yellow terminal state. The Friendly regression proves outer-log, Panic, generated ReachPoint, pre-existing self stimulus, and sibling order with exactly two `AiPanic` draws; the Enemy control proves a locking sibling preserves a later duplicate marker and suffix. Both focused tests and the full 3,038-test robin_engine library suite pass. A fresh optimized runner matches the representative and Task36 control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x-schema14/traces/Savegame_Nescafe/Profile_001/Savegame_001/replay-009-session-0001.jsonl.zst` through exact EOF.
